_note: MuseStudio bridge settings (the bridge began as MetaMuse Stage's, the Godot version's, and keeps its routes). Relative paths are relative to this file. Copy this to bridge_config.json (this PC's own, never in the repository) and set allowed_hosts before Muse connects (MUSE_GUIDE 7.1).
_legacy_note: web_root, kkdata_root, web_data_list, characters_dir: the Godot version's paths (its web export at GET /, its data at /kkdata, its saved characters for characters_source saves). MuseStudio uses none of them. They stay, with the values the bridge defaults to anyway, because the bridge's tests and MuseStudio/tools/run_checks.py read them from this file. With no web export, GET / shows static/no_web_build.html.
_characters_note: GET /api/characters: characters_source cards = MuseStudio's character cards (card_dirs, read on each request); saves = the Godot app's saved characters (characters_dir)
_persona_note: MuseStudio's registered personas (its menu writes the file): each card's persona in /api/characters
_auth_note: Who may use the bridge (the security review of 2026-11-05, SEC-01/06; MUSE_GUIDE 7.1): auth "required" (the default) asks every request for a token - Muse's or the app's, made at the first start in tokens_file (this PC only: never in the repository, a chat or a log; python bridge.py --print-token muse shows Muse's, for the user to hand over) - while GET /health answers only that the bridge is alive. Required from the start: make the tokens (the first start), set allowed_hosts and Tailscale's serve, then hand Muse its key - there is no tokenless period. "off" (no token) is for the bridge's own tests, never for a bridge Muse connects to: any machine of the tailnet could read the state and send packages. allowed_hosts lists this PC's other names a request may come by (the tailnet name Tailscale's serve passes on, e.g. "mypc.tailxxxx.ts.net"): any other Host is refused (DNS rebinding), browser or not.
_cors_note: false (the default): no web page of another site may use the bridge - Muse, the app and the tools send no browser headers and are not affected; the bridge's own pages on 127.0.0.1 / localhost are. A list of origins ("http://host:port") lets those sites in; true lets every site in (not recommended).
_match_note: The Muse-to-Muse match's relay: relay_url is the default one (the public ntfy); relay_allow lists the other relays this bridge may talk to (for example your own on the LAN: "http://192.168.1.20:18793") - a relay an invitation names is used only when it is one of these (the security review of 2026-11-05, SEC-05). A name listed here is trusted with its DNS too: the bridge does not check the address the name resolves to, so list only relays you or your opponent run and trust (an http:// one above all).

irodori._enabled_note: false: the voice is off - the bridge never calls Irodori, the launcher does not start it, blocks stay silent (Muse's voice labels still drive the faces). The user's decision 2026-11-03: Irodori running alongside is too heavy; set true to have the voice again.
